title: Winter/Skill history
wikitext:
{{Skill history}}
__NoToC__

== August 25, 2005 ==
* The effects of [[Spirit]]s no longer work on other Spirits.
: ''Example: '''Fertile Season''' no longer adds [[Health]] and [[Armor rating|armor]] to other Spirits.''
* When a Spirit is cast, it kills all other [[Ally|allied]] Spirits of the same type within its [[Spirit range|range]].
{{clear}}

== July 13, 2005 ==
* Fixed [[Ward spell|wards]], [[spirit]]s, and [[Well spell|wells]] so that [[Character|players]] who are [[Resurrection|resurrected]] within the [[area of effect]] receive that [[Spell|spell's]] effect after resurrection.
{{clear}}

== June 1, 2005 ==
* Fixed [[skill]] '''Winter''' so that all [[elemental damage]] is converted to [[cold damage|cold]]. 
{{clear}}
